```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)

data_path <- function(...) {
  path_from_analysis <- file.path("..", "data", ...)
  path_from_project <- file.path("data", ...)

  if (file.exists(path_from_analysis)) {
    return(path_from_analysis)
  }
  if (file.exists(path_from_project)) {
    return(path_from_project)
  }

  stop("Could not find data file: ", file.path(...), call. = FALSE)
}

to_binary_correct <- function(x) {
  x_chr <- tolower(as.character(x))
  case_when(
    x_chr %in% c("true", "1") ~ 1L,
    x_chr %in% c("false", "0") ~ 0L,
    TRUE ~ NA_integer_
  )
}
```

## Load datasets

```{r}
performance_raw <- read_csv(
  data_path("performance", "trials_df.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

density_raw <- read_csv(
  data_path("speech_density", "speech_density_trial_level.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

density_bins_raw <- read_csv(
  data_path("speech_density", "speech_density_bin_level_K5.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

rate_raw <- read_csv(
  data_path("speech_rate", "speech_rate_trial_level.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Task Performance

```{r}
performance_df <- performance_raw %>%
  mutate(
    is_correct = to_binary_correct(is_correct),
    participant_id = factor(participant_id),
    group = factor(
      as.character(group),
      levels = c("1", "2"),
      labels = c("Same-Type", "Different-Type")
    ),
    problem_type = relevel(factor(task_type), ref = "value-loose-chunk"),
    trial_number = as.integer(trial_number),
    trial_c = as.numeric(scale(trial_number, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE)),
    log_rt = log(ifelse(rt > 0, rt, NA_real_))
  )
```

### Accuracy Across Trials

```{r}
model_accuracy <- glmer(
  is_correct ~ trial_c * group + problem_type + (1 + trial_c | participant_id),
  data = performance_df,
  family = binomial,
  control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(model_accuracy)
```

```{r}
predicted_accuracy <- emmeans(
  model_accuracy,
  ~ trial_c | group,
  at = list(trial_c = c(-2, -1, 0, 1, 2)),
  type = "response"
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(trial_number = trial_c + 3)

same_predictions <- filter(predicted_accuracy, group == "Same-Type")
different_predictions <- filter(predicted_accuracy, group == "Different-Type")

cat(
  "Same-Type, Trial 1 predicted accuracy:",
  same_predictions$prob[same_predictions$trial_number == 1],
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Same-Type, Trial 5 predicted accuracy:",
  same_predictions$prob[same_predictions$trial_number == 5],
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Different-Type, minimum predicted accuracy (Trials 1-5):",
  min(different_predictions$prob),
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Different-Type, maximum predicted accuracy (Trials 1-5):",
  max(different_predictions$prob),
  "\n"
)
```

### Response Times Across Trials

```{r}
performance_correct_df <- performance_df %>%
  filter(is_correct == 1, !is.na(log_rt))

model_rt <- lmer(
  log_rt ~ trial_c * group + problem_type + (1 + trial_c | participant_id),
  data = performance_correct_df,
  control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa")
)

summary(model_rt)
```

## Speech Density

```{r}
density_df <- density_raw %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = factor(participant_id),
    group = relevel(factor(as.character(group)), ref = "1"),
    task_type = factor(task_type),
    phase = factor(phase),
    is_correct = to_binary_correct(is_correct)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(speech_ratio_audio), is.finite(speech_ratio_audio))
```

### Correct Versus Incorrect Trials

```{r}
model_density_correctness <- lmer(
  speech_ratio_audio ~ is_correct * group + task_type + (1 + is_correct | participant_id),
  data = density_df,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(model_density_correctness)
anova(model_density_correctness)
```

```{r}
density_correctness_overall <- emmeans(
  model_density_correctness,
  ~ is_correct,
  weights = "proportional"
)

contrast(density_correctness_overall, method = "revpairwise")
```

### Problem-Solving Phases

```{r}
density_phase_df <- density_df %>%
  mutate(
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("pre_incorrect", "first_correct", "post_correct", "post_incorrect")
    ),
    phase = relevel(phase, ref = "first_correct")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase))

model_density_phase <- lmer(
  speech_ratio_audio ~ phase * group + task_type + (1 | participant_id),
  data = density_phase_df,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(model_density_phase)
anova(model_density_phase)
```

```{r}
density_phase_emm <- emmeans(model_density_phase, ~ phase | group)

density_phase_contrasts <- contrast(
  density_phase_emm,
  method = list(
    "first_correct - pre_incorrect" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),
    "post_correct - first_correct" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0)
  ),
  adjust = "none"
)

summary(density_phase_contrasts)
```

### Five Temporal Bins

```{r}
density_bins_df <- density_bins_raw %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = factor(participant_id),
    group = relevel(factor(as.character(group)), ref = "1"),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("first_correct", "post_correct", "pre_incorrect", "post_incorrect")
    ),
    task_type = factor(task_type),
    bin_idx = relevel(factor(bin_idx), ref = "1")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase), is.finite(speech_density))

model_density_bins <- lmer(
  speech_density ~ phase * group * bin_idx + task_type + (1 | participant_id),
  data = density_bins_df,
  REML = FALSE
)

anova(model_density_bins)
```

```{r}
density_bin_phase_emm <- emmeans(
  model_density_bins,
  ~ phase | group * bin_idx
)

post_minus_first_by_bin <- contrast(
  density_bin_phase_emm,
  method = list("post_correct - first_correct" = c(-1, 1, 0, 0)),
  adjust = "none"
)

summary(post_minus_first_by_bin, infer = TRUE)
```

## Speech Rate

```{r}
rate_df <- rate_raw %>%
  mutate(
    participant_id = factor(participant_id),
    group = relevel(factor(as.character(group)), ref = "1"),
    task_type = factor(task_type),
    phase = factor(
      phase,
      levels = c("first_correct", "pre_incorrect", "post_correct", "post_incorrect")
    ),
    wps_used = as.numeric(wps_used)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(phase), is.finite(wps_used))

model_rate_phase <- lmer(
  wps_used ~ phase * group + task_type + (1 | participant_id),
  data = rate_df,
  REML = FALSE
)

summary(model_rate_phase)
anova(model_rate_phase)
```

```{r}
rate_phase_emm <- emmeans(model_rate_phase, ~ phase | group)

rate_phase_contrasts <- contrast(
  rate_phase_emm,
  method = list(
    "first_correct - pre_incorrect" = c(1, -1, 0, 0),
    "post_correct - first_correct" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0)
  ),
  adjust = "none"
)

summary(rate_phase_contrasts)
```
